newsitem.title: UK: Yorkshire-Tyne Tees up amid further bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Yorkshire-Tyne Tees up amid further bid talk.

text.p: Shares in Yorkshire-Tyne Tees Plc leapt on Friday, extending gains earlier this week sparked by renewed talk of a bid from Granada Group Plc, dealers said.
YTV shares were up 65p at 12.37-1/2 by 1057 GMT in thin volume of 43,203 shares.
"There is no new story, it is just the usual stuff about a Granada bid," said one market-maker.
Long-standing talk of a bid from Granada revived earlier this week after the company raised 476 million stg through the sale of its Wellcome Break hotel chain to Bahrain-based Investcorp.
Shares in Granada were down 6-1/2p at 920-1/2 in volume of 2.6 million shares.
